try_different_search_or_create: Gerageza irindi jambo ryo gushakisha cyangwa ukore ububiko bushya bushobora gucapwa.
slug_taken_error: Iyi slug yamaze gukoreshwa. Hitamo indi.
share_slug_missing_tooltip: Shyiraho uburyo bwo gusangira amakuru rusange mbere yo gusangira
unable_to_update_directory: Ntibishoboka kuvugurura ububiko bw'ibitabo bushobora gucapwa
unable_to_create_directory: Ntibishoboka gukora ububiko bw'ibitabo bushobora gucapwa
unable_to_delete_directory: Ntibishoboka gusiba ububiko bw'ibitabo bushobora gucapwa
delete_directory_description: Ese wizeye ko ushaka gusiba iyi directory ishobora gucapwa? Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
load_error: Ntibishoboka gufungura ububiko bw'amakuru. Nyamuneka ongera ugerageze.
back_to_directories: Garuka ku bitabo by'ububiko bishobora gucapwa
cover_image_description: Shyiraho ishusho y'igifuniko cy'imbere kugira ngo isimbuze urupapuro rw'umutwe/ibisobanuro, n'ishusho y'igifuniko cy'inyuma kugira ngo wongereho urupapuro rusoza. Niba nta mashusho yashyizweho, ububiko bukoresha igifuniko cy'inyandiko gisanzwe.
footer_config_description: Inyandiko yo munsi y'urupapuro n'imiterere y'aho iherereye.
layout_reorder_hint: Kanda kuri + kugira ngo wongere ikintu ku miterere. Koresha utwambi twongere dutondeke ibintu byatoranijwe.
query_param_overrides_default_location: Iyi parametero y'ikibazo ihindura imiterere y'ahantu isanzwe
no_sources: Iki gice nta masoko kiraboneka. Jya ku bisubizo by'ishakisha cyangwa urutonde rw'ibyo ukunda hanyuma ubibike hano.
public_preview_meta_description: Ububiko bw'inyandiko bushobora gucapwa bwasangiwe nawe.
public_preview_ready: Gukuramo kwawe bigomba gutangira mu buryo bwikora.
public_preview_error: Hari ikintu kitagenze neza mu gukora iyi PDF.
share_dialog_description: Hitamo imiterere abagenerwabikorwa bazabona, hanyuma ukope iyi link.
wizard_step2_description: Shaka icyo igice cya mbere kigomba gushyira ku rutonde, hanyuma uhitemo aho ububiko buherereye. Ushobora kongeramo ibindi bice hanyuma ugahindura aho uherereye nyuma.
wizard_query_help: Ubishatse — ushobora no kongeramo ibi nyuma uhereye ku ipaji y'ububiko.
share_url_help: Umuntu wese ufite iyi link ashobora gukuramo PDF. Kuyihindura bigabanya link wari waramaze gusangiza.

access_policy_description.private: Ni wowe wenyine ushobora gufungura no kuyihindura hano.
access_policy_description.shared_read: Abandi bakoresha bashobora kubona ububiko bw'amakuru bushobora gusohoka; ni wowe wenyine ushobora kubuhindura.
access_policy_description.shared_edit: Abandi bakoresha bashobora kubona ububiko bw'amakuru bushobora gufungurwa no guhindurwa.

capability_required: Konti yawe ntabwo irimo iki gikorwa.

localized_field.auto_translate_hint: Indimi zirimo ubusa zihindurwa mu buryo bwikora iyo ubitse. Ubuhinduzi bwahinduwe burabikwa.

languages_help: Indimi iyi directory yahinduwemo kandi ishobora gucapwa cyangwa gusangirwamo.
wizard_location_help: Ikoreshwa na buri gice kitagena aho giherereye.
unable_to_add_source: Ububiko bwakozwe, ariko ikibazo cyabwo nticyashoboye kongerwamo. Ushobora kubwongeraho uhereye ku ipaji y'ububiko.
logo_help: Byacapwe aho imiterere y'umutwe cyangwa iy'inyuma irimo ikirango. Iyo nta na kimwe, ikirango cy'urubuga kirakoreshwa.
